finalText:
**Build passes now, exit 0.**

Two real bugs, both from the bump.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`. The new shape is `retryCount`. Fixed in [src/core/options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7).

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`. Now unset means off, the old default. Fixed in [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings are hardcoded strings in `build.js`. They name files that do not exist here.

Next: nothing, the warnings are pure noise.
